instruction: Turn on Windows Live captions and use them to read the council service recording on the Desktop. Save the pickup location, collection hours, item to bring, and reference number to `answer.txt`, one item per line.
transcript: Council service update. Your parking permit documents are ready for pickup at the Civic Service Centre, counter 4. Collection hours are 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM. Bring photo ID. Reference number PS-482.
gt_steps: Play `CouncilPickupAudio.mp3` in Chrome with Windows Live captions running.

Enter `Civic Service Centre, counter 4
9:00 AM-4:30 PM
Photo ID
PS-482`, one item per line.
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.

command: $found = Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'LiveCaptions|LiveCaption' -or $_.MainWindowTitle -match 'Live captions|Live Caption' }; if ($found) { 'WINDOWS_LIVE_CAPTIONS_RUNNING' } else { 'WINDOWS_LIVE_CAPTIONS_NOT_RUNNING' }
